subject: [RFC PATCH 4/7] mm/shmem: handle memory.high overage in fallocate and reads

2026-11-22.patch_summary: This patch addresses a memory.high overage issue in the shmem (tmpfs and memfd) code. When fallocate() is called on tmpfs or memfd, it allocates a large range of memory at once, which can lead to an overage of the memory.high limit if swap space is not available. The patch introduces a new mechanism to handle this overage by reclaiming folios after each fallocate iteration and after each folio read, where only inode_lock is held. This approach ensures that huge pages are also handled correctly. In the presence of swap space, the patch prevents the fallocating task's own memory.high reclaim attempts from counting towards the overage limit, thus preventing unnecessary failures with -ENOMEM.
